gpu.spoofedNote: The renderer name above comes from the Linux webview, which reports the same fake value on every machine. Ignore it. The WebGL version line is real.
gpu.title: The 3D view could not start
gpu.tryThese: Two things are worth trying. Close SindriCAD, then start it again from a terminal with one of these in front of the usual command:

why.noWebgl: This computer could not create a 3D context of any kind. That usually means the graphics driver is missing or is being blocked, rather than anything wrong with SindriCAD itself.
why.renderer: This computer reports WebGL 2, but the 3D view still could not be created. That is unusual, and I would like to see the report.
why.webgl1Only: This computer's graphics driver offers OpenGL ES 2.0 only, and the 3D view needs WebGL 2. That is a limit of the driver, not a damaged install. On Linux it usually means an older NVIDIA card running on the open-source nouveau driver.

gpu.workaroundNote: The first draws in software on the CPU. It is slower on large models, but it works where the driver does not. The second turns off the webview's shared-buffer path, which some drivers do not implement correctly.

error.pointAtCentre: That point sits at the circle's centre — the distance to its edge IS its radius, so dimension the radius instead.
error.pointOnCircle: That point lies on the circle — the distance to the edge measures 0, nothing to drive.
error.pointOnLine: That point lies on the line — the distance measures 0, nothing to drive.
error.rimsTouch: These two rims touch — the edge-to-edge distance measures 0, nothing to drive.
error.sameCircleTwice: That is one circle picked twice — pick a second entity to measure to.

prompt.arc: Arc: click start, click end, then click a point it passes through · Esc
prompt.break: Break: click a line or arc to split it (a circle opens into an arc) · Esc
prompt.centerRectangle: Center Rectangle: click the center, then a corner · Esc
prompt.chamfer: Chamfer: click two lines, then type a setback distance + Enter · Esc
prompt.circle: Circle: click center, then radius · type ⌀ · Enter · Esc
prompt.circle2: Circle (2-point): click two points on the diameter · Esc
prompt.circle3: Circle (3-point): click three points the circle passes through · Esc
prompt.coincident: Coincident: click two endpoints to make them coincide · Esc
prompt.collinear: Collinear: click two lines to put them on the same axis · Esc
prompt.concentric: Concentric: click two circles/arcs to share a center · Esc
prompt.copy: Copy: select entities, then click a base point and a destination (originals kept) · Esc
prompt.dimension: Dimension: click a line (length) or circle (⌀), type a value + Enter · Esc
prompt.equal: Equal: click two lines (equal length) or two circles/arcs (equal radius) · Esc
prompt.extend: Extend: click a line or arc near an end to lengthen it to the nearest crossing · Esc
prompt.fillet: Fillet: click two lines, then type a radius + Enter · Esc
prompt.fix: Fix: click a point, endpoint or circle/arc center to lock it in place · Esc
prompt.horizontal: Horizontal: click a line to make it horizontal · Esc
prompt.line: Line: click points · type length + Tab + angle · Enter to commit · click the start to close · Esc
prompt.midpoint: Midpoint: click a point/endpoint, then a line — the point sits at its midpoint · Esc
prompt.mirror: Mirror: with entities selected, click a line to mirror across · Esc
prompt.move: Move: select entities first, then click a base point and a destination · Esc
prompt.offset: Offset: click a curve, then type an offset distance + Enter · Esc
prompt.parallel: Parallel: click two lines to make the 2nd parallel to the 1st · Esc
prompt.point: Point: click to place a reference point (snaps + constrains) · Esc
prompt.polygon: Polygon: click the center, then a vertex (6-sided, inscribed) · Esc
prompt.rectangle: Rectangle: click two corners · type W, Tab, H · Enter · Esc
prompt.rotate: Rotate: select entities, click a center, then type an angle + Enter · Esc
prompt.scale: Scale: select entities, click a base point, then type a factor + Enter · Esc
prompt.select: Select: click geometry to pick it · drag to move · Delete to remove · or pick a tool: Line (L) · Rectangle (R) · Circle (C) · Arc (A)
prompt.slot: Slot: click the two arc centers, then a point for the width · Esc
prompt.spline: Spline: click to place fit points · click the last point or press Enter to finish · Esc to cancel
prompt.symmetric: Symmetric: click two endpoints, then the symmetry axis line · Esc
prompt.tangent: Tangent: click two curves (line, circle or arc) to make them tangent · Esc
prompt.trim: Trim: click a curve (line/arc/circle) to remove it up to the nearest crossings · Esc
prompt.vertical: Vertical: click a line to make it vertical · Esc
